scope: Coarse scene-conditioned speech control, limited narrative repertoire; not unrestricted storytelling
supervision: 12 predefined scene classes mapped deterministically to authored equal-token-length Italian sentences; VLM categories used only during training preparation
final_inference: image -> frozen normalized 768D embedding -> global MLP -> continuous prefix -> frozen Qwen audio; no classifier, scene strings or template lookup at inference
old_cohort: previous 62 images for a matched canonical-supervision diagnostic
fresh_exclusion: all earlier inventory capture-day groups and earlier selected perceptual neighbors; exact duplicates removed
fresh_access_rule: no fresh labels, features, target projection or performance checks until development gate passes
length_policy: one common teacher token length chosen before seeing image labels; constant head, no padding or length regression
architecture: same width128 LayerNorm/global MLP; frozen vision and Qwen
speaker_and_generation_seed: same local reference, seed42, sampled codec0/residuals, cap105
publication: only generic source and aggregate verification; all image-derived artifacts remain local
